1031	from it. What is meant? It nullifies every concealment, every impurity

1033	can exist exists only until the hidden light, the moment
1034	the hidden light is revealed. For all impurity exists by

1039	can exist and act at a time

1041	One, blessed be He. For all the temptations and all the concealments and all
